response.query: What Big-O time and memory complexity targets should we advertise for key kernels, and what empirical benchmark matrix (n, p, T, K, B) will guide default parameter choices?
response.answer: Advertise O(n^2) time and O(n) memory for key kernels. Default parameters: n=1000, p=10, T=100, K=10, B=100.
